sim: **闸 2：距离单独做不到，用数字说。** 1.28 MWt 给出中子泄漏 1.5e16 n/s；裸源 100 m 处 17.4 Sv/h。按平方反比退到 1 mSv/年连续需要 **1,236 km**；就算放宽到「不给全城已经承受的 234 mSv/年再加 1%」也要 **808 km**。**所需退避距离是这颗行星半径的 36%，是全城直径的 494 倍。距离不是屏蔽策略，是屏蔽策略上的一个舍入误差。**（与 pwr-grid-01 接地卡「所需接地极比行星本身还大」是同一形状的答案。）
**埋起来之后，曲线塌成悬崖。** 地面上的受体与堆芯之间没有直视线——射线要从土丘**侧面**出去，水平路径 ≥15 m 即 exp(−67)，任何距离上都是死的。剩下两条路：站在丘顶（4.5 m 路径），和**天空散射**。
**火星的天空散射几乎不存在。** 大气 0.02 kg/m³，快中子散射平均自由程 14.3 km（地球 0.23 km，差 61 倍）。单次散射估算给出 500 m 处 1.7e-4 n/cm²/s、剂量 0.0002 µSv/h——天然地表本底 26.7 µSv/h 的百万分之九。**在地球上，天空散射是长距离屏蔽的克星；在火星，挡住直视线之后基本没有东西剩下可挡。**

**厚度 vs 距离的取舍表**（同为围栏处 25 µSv/h）：覆土 2.0 m → 禁区半径 3,054 m（29 km²）；2.5 m → 1,110 m；3.0 m → 396 m；**4.0 m → 49 m（0.008 km²）**。**从 2.5 m 加到 4.0 m 只多 1,500 m³ 土，禁区半径缩小 22 倍、面积缩小 500 倍。** 衰减对厚度是指数、对距离只是平方，指数永远赢，而在行星上指数是免费的。**2.0 m 时那个禁区圈比整座城的占地还大——你根本没有那么多地可以送。**
**同样的 20 个自由程若从地球运来**：LiH 需 154 cm 厚壳，单模块 119 t，八台 954 t ≈ **10 艘星舰货运**。对照推土机的 161 小时。**这就是它被埋起来的全部理由。**

**灵敏度（闸 3）：λ_n 是本账最弱的数字，结论必须扛住它。** λ 从 16 到 30 cm 扫描，丘顶剂量摆动了五个数量级（0.1 → 17,000 µSv/h）——所以丘顶被判为**签牌管制区而不是设计驻留点**。但选址结论毫发无损：500 m 处的天空散射在整个范围内都比天然本底低 4~6 个数量级。**措施：按 4.0 m 建，并在土丘上预留加高 1.0 m 的余地，等首次投运实测衰减后再定。风化层是唯一一种可以事后追加的屏蔽——地球运来的 LiH 是两年前在另一颗行星上做的决定。**

**掺冰增氢：诱人，算完否决。** 20% 冰的胶结风化层 λ 降到 12.5 cm（1.8 倍改善），且冰只能放在外层（内 2 m 越过 273 K）——恰好也是氢最该放的位置。但 0.5 m 冰壳要 **243 t 水 = res-rodwell-01 全井 639 sol 的产量**，而全城水银行只有 26 m³。否决。**同样的衰减，把土丘加高 0.5 m 只要 21 个装载机小时。在火星，土是便宜的屏蔽、水是昂贵的屏蔽；地球上每一座研究堆都泡在水池里，库存关系反过来了，设计也就反过来。**

**本卡明确不覆盖的三件事**：① 穿透件流泄——一条直通管道能废掉几米屏蔽，故每根热管、NaK 母管与电缆穿透都做两道 90° 折弯并朝上坡方向出口（几何里画了）；② 超设计基准——没有任何可达距离能防住屏蔽尽失（500 m 处裸堆 1 Sv/h），答案是 4 m 压实风化层不是会失效的工程屏障，它是一座山，且堆芯按温度被动停堆；③ 场址活化——覆土俘获生成微量 Na-24/Fe-59，留在土里，而土本来就在那儿。

**【第二轮 L2 · 账 11：OpenMC 连续能量输运，替掉 1 群移出模型】** 在 Ubuntu HEP 虚拟机上跑 OpenMC 0.15.3（真 ENDF 截面）。**声明的近似**：该机截面库只有 24 种核素、缺 Al/Mg/Ca/Na/Ti/S——即耶泽罗玄武岩的 19 wt%——故按**平均质量数**折入 Si28（91%）与 Fe56（9%）；得 ⟨A⟩ = 22.31，对 **sci-cray-01 为完全不同目的（风化层量能器）独立发表的 22.6 差 1.3%**，这是闸不是自证。**结果：λ_n = 19.0 cm，而账 5 用的文献值是 22.4 cm——真实屏蔽每厘米比 L1 模型好 1.18 倍**，且局域 λ 在 40 cm 处就稳定，说明穿透谱已硬化、单指数在那之后合法（账 5 假设了这点却没验）。满厚度上账 5 的「指数×线性积累因子」比输运结果保守 **5,553 倍**，丘顶剂量从 145 µSv/h 落到 ~0.03 µSv/h（天然地表本底 26.7 µSv/h）。**校核：水（该库精确表示）得 6.3 cm，落在预期带内。**

**但不许因此削薄覆土（账 11）**：① 这是**代用成分**加纯 Watt 源谱，余量现在是已知的，却是通过一个有声明软肋的模型知道的；② **光子输运整个关着**——账 5 证明源伽马输给中子 71:1，但**在 4 m 厚屏蔽内部由俘获生成的次级伽马是另一回事，本轮完全没建模，而它正是厚屏蔽里的经典后段项**，**这就是我下一步要补的缺口，也是唯一可能把丘顶数字推回去的一项**；③ 覆土是 4,831 m³ 的推土机活。**账 5「风化层是本设计里最便宜的东西」的结论被加强而不是削弱**——我们只是发现自己多了 1.64 m 的余量。

**流泄：账 5 声明未算，现在算了，而且发现手册数字用错了地方（账 11）。** 1 m 覆土、30 cm 管径、探测器是贴在出口的 25 cm 圆饼：实心 1.00× / 直通管 **5.23×** / 一道 90° 折弯 **3.22×**——**一道折弯只找回直通损失的 48%，合 1.6 倍，而不是账 5 引用的 1e2~1e3。** 原因是纵横比：这个测试是 30 cm 穿 1 m，即 3.3:1，**又肥又短的洞，一道弯关不上**；手册那个 1e2/弯 假设的是细长管。真实覆土 4 m 给 13:1，折弯在那里有效得多。**新设计规则，而且这次带理由：穿透件按纵横比定尺寸，不按折弯数量；最少两道弯。**

**【第二轮 L1 · 账 13：边坡这条我说得不完整】** 本卡说 1:1.5 边坡「在 0.38 g 下保守，因为驱动应力随重力标度而填料的黏聚力不随」。机理对，话不完整：**摩擦阻力也随重力标度，而且精确抵消。** 干燥无黏聚填料的安全系数是 tan φ / tan β，**与重力无关**——1:1.5、φ=37° 在两颗行星上都是 **1.13，低于工程惯例要求的 1.5**。重力只通过**黏聚力项**帮忙，而那里帮得很多（c=2 kPa 时火星 1.84 对地球 1.40）。**新要求：压实填料须实测 c ≥ 2.1 kPa，否则边坡放缓到 1:2**（无黏聚力即达 1.51，代价是丘底从 52 m 涨到 63 m、覆土方量 +44%）。**真正属于火星的那条优势在别处**：地球上要加 0.1~0.15 g 的拟静力地震系数、把安全系数打掉三成，而火星是我们量过的最安静的类地行星（InSight 四年最大 M4.7、距 2000 km），拟静力项可以忽略。

**埋一座反应堆在火星上便宜 2.6 倍，而这条此前没人写（账 13）**：屏蔽买的是**面密度**（g/cm²），结构付的是**面密度 × g**。同样 4 m 覆土在火星是 24.5 kPa、在地球是 64.7 kPa。**同样的屏蔽，火星的顶板只承 1/2.6 的载荷。** 但 18 m 净跨的平板弯矩仍有 992 kN·m/m——**几何已据此改过一半**：中间那排立柱已经画进洞库（跨度减半，弯矩降到 1/4）；**拱形衬里（3 m 矢高时纯压推力 331 kN/m）仍未画，如实标为下一版**。洞库叫 vault，就该长成 vault 的样子——现在只做到了一半。

**【第三轮 L2+L1 · 账 14：账 11 自己点名的缺口，补上了】** 账 11 关着光子输运并写下「4 m 厚屏蔽内部由俘获生成的次级伽马是另一回事……这是我下一步要补的缺口，也是唯一可能把丘顶数字推回去的一项」。虚拟机的光子截面在下载到一半时被对端拒绝连接，所以改成**两段拼接**:**L2 段**用 OpenMC 中子输运给出**俘获在屏蔽体内的空间分布** R(z)（即次级伽马的源项）,**L1 段**用点核 + 积累因子把这些伽马解析地送到表面。这样反而比黑箱耦合更透明——看得见伽马在哪儿出生、还剩多少屏蔽要穿。**顺带把成分也修了**：合并两个截面库后，真实耶泽罗玄武岩只有 Ti(1.0 wt%)缺数据要折入 Fe，而账 11 的代用成分折掉了 19 wt%——**成分保真度提高 19 倍**。

**铁拿走了 63% 的俘获，而铁俘获是一次 7.65 MeV 的事件（账 14）。** 按「质量分数 ÷ A × 热俘获截面」排序,Fe-56 主导;Si-28 8.47 MeV、Al-27 7.73、Ca-40 8.36 紧随。**关键在于 7.6 MeV 光子在硅酸盐里的衰减长度是 23 cm，比中子的 19.0 cm 还长。**于是：一个从屏蔽体**背面附近**出生的俘获伽马只需穿过剩下的几十厘米，而从正面进来的中子要穿 450 cm。结果是 γ/n 比值**随厚度增长**——正是账 11 担心的那个机制。实算:64.3× 在 4.5 m 处(1.35× 在 1 m 处)。**这座屏蔽在 4.5 m 上是伽马限制的，不是中子限制的。**

**但结论活下来了，而且覆土一厘米都不动（账 14）**：丘顶剂量从账 11 的中子 0.026 µSv/h 变成**1.697 µSv/h**，仍是天然地表本底 26.7 µSv/h 的 **1/16**。**改变的是答案的结构而不是答案**：此后任何人想用「减薄覆土」做交易，买到的会比账 5 的指数少得多——因为他要交易的是 λ_γ = 23 cm，不是 λ_n = 19 cm。**便宜的旋钮（已登记，未指定）**：俘获伽马是**热**中子造的，在覆土内面铺几厘米含硼层(B-10 俘获只放 0.48 MeV，不是 7.6)，源项就大幅消失。本城硼来源不明，而且**根本不需要**——丘顶已经比本底低两个数量级。写在这里是为了让下一个人知道该拧哪个旋钮。
sim_en: GATE 2: DISTANCE ALONE CANNOT DO IT, WITH A NUMBER. 1.28 MWt gives a neutron leakage of 1.5e16 n/s and 17.4 Sv/h at 100 m bare. Falling off as inverse square to 1 mSv/yr continuous needs 1,236 km; even the far laxer 'do not add 1% to the 234 mSv/yr the city already takes' needs 808 km. THE REQUIRED STAND-OFF IS 36% OF A PLANETARY RADIUS AND 494 CITY DIAMETERS. Distance is not a shielding strategy, it is a rounding error on one. (The same shape of answer as pwr-grid-01's bonding card: the required earth electrode is bigger than the planet.)

ONCE IT IS BURIED, THE CURVE COLLAPSES INTO A CLIFF. A receptor at ground level has no line of sight to the core - the ray leaves through the SIDE of the mound, a horizontal path of 15 m or more, i.e. exp(-67), which is dead at any distance. Two paths remain: standing on the crest (a 4.5 m path), and SKYSHINE.

MARTIAN SKYSHINE BARELY EXISTS. At 0.02 kg/m3 the fast-neutron scattering mean free path is 14.3 km against Earth's 0.23 km, 61x weaker. A single-scatter estimate gives 1.7e-4 n/cm2/s at 500 m, a dose of 0.0002 uSv/h - nine parts per million of the 26.7 uSv/h natural surface background. ON EARTH SKYSHINE IS WHAT DEFEATS LONG-RANGE SHIELDING; ON MARS, ONCE THE DIRECT LINE IS BLOCKED THERE IS ESSENTIALLY NOTHING LEFT TO BLOCK.

THE THICKNESS-VERSUS-DISTANCE TRADE, at a fixed 25 uSv/h at the fence: 2.0 m of cover needs a 3,054 m exclusion radius (29 km2); 2.5 m needs 1,110 m; 3.0 m needs 396 m; 4.0 m NEEDS 49 m (0.008 km2). GOING FROM 2.5 TO 4.0 m COSTS 1,500 m3 OF DIRT AND SHRINKS THE EXCLUSION RADIUS 22-FOLD AND ITS AREA 500-FOLD. Attenuation is exponential in thickness and only quadratic in distance; the exponential always wins, and on a planet the exponential is free. AT 2.0 m THE EXCLUSION CIRCLE IS LARGER THAN THE ENTIRE CITY FOOTPRINT - there is not that much ground to give away.

THE SAME 20 MEAN FREE PATHS, IF FLOWN FROM EARTH: 154 cm of LiH in a shell is 119 t per module and 954 t for eight - about TEN STARSHIP CARGO FLIGHTS - against 161 hours of loader time. That is the entire reason it is buried.

SENSITIVITY (gate 3): lambda_n is the weakest number in this account and the conclusion has to survive it. Sweeping lambda from 16 to 30 cm swings the crest dose across five decades (0.1 to 17,000 uSv/h) - which is why the crest is classed as a SIGNED CONTROLLED AREA RATHER THAN A DESIGN OCCUPANCY. The siting conclusion is untouched: skyshine at 500 m stays four to six decades below natural background across the whole range. ACTION: build to 4.0 m and leave room on the mound to add 1.0 m once the first commissioning survey measures the real attenuation. REGOLITH IS THE ONLY SHIELD YOU CAN ADD AFTER THE FACT - a LiH shield is a decision made two years earlier on another planet.

ADDING HYDROGEN: TEMPTING, COSTED, REJECTED. Ice-bonded regolith at 20% ice takes lambda to 12.5 cm, a 1.8x improvement, and the ice can only live in the outer shell (the inner 2 m crosses 273 K) - which happens to be where hydrogen belongs anyway. But a 0.5 m ice skin needs 243 t of water = 639 SOLS OF THE ENTIRE res-rodwell-01 WELL, against a city water bank of 26 m3. Rejected. The same attenuation costs 21 loader-hours if you simply make the hill 0.5 m taller. ON MARS DIRT IS THE CHEAP SHIELD AND WATER IS THE EXPENSIVE ONE; on Earth every research reactor sits in a water pool. The inventory inverts, and so does the design.

THREE THINGS THIS CARD EXPLICITLY DOES NOT COVER: (1) duct streaming - a straight penetration defeats metres of shield, so every heat pipe, NaK header and cable penetration takes two 90-degree dog-legs and exits up-slope, away from the city (it is drawn in the geometry); (2) beyond-design-basis - no achievable distance protects against total loss of shielding (a bare core reads 1 Sv/h at 500 m), and the answer is that 4 m of compacted regolith is not an engineered barrier that can fail, it is a hill, and the cores scram passively on temperature; (3) site activation - capture in the cover makes trace Na-24 and Fe-59, which stays in the cover, which is where it already was.

SECOND ROUND, L2, LEDGER 11 - OpenMC CONTINUOUS-ENERGY TRANSPORT REPLACES THE 1-GROUP REMOVAL MODEL. Run on the Ubuntu HEP VM with OpenMC 0.15.3 and real ENDF cross sections. DECLARED APPROXIMATION: that library carries only 24 nuclides and has no Al/Mg/Ca/Na/Ti/S - 19 wt% of Jezero basalt - so those are folded into Si28 (91%) and Fe56 (9%) by matching the MEAN MASS NUMBER. The surrogate gives <A> = 22.31 against the 22.6 sci-cray-01 published for a completely different purpose (a regolith calorimeter), 1.3% apart - a gate, not self-certification. RESULT: lambda_n = 19.0 cm against ledger 5's literature 22.4 cm, so the real shield is 1.18x better per centimetre than the L1 model assumed; and the local lambda settles by 40 cm, confirming the penetrating spectrum has hardened and a single exponential is legitimate beyond that - which ledger 5 assumed without checking. At full thickness ledger 5's exponential-times-linear-buildup was 5,553x CONSERVATIVE, taking the crest dose from 145 uSv/h to about 0.03 uSv/h against a 26.7 uSv/h natural surface background. VALIDATION: water, which this library represents exactly, comes out at 6.3 cm, inside the expected band.

BUT THE COVER IS NOT THINNED ON THIS (ledger 11): (1) it is a SURROGATE composition with a pure Watt source - the margin is now known, but known through a model with a declared soft spot; (2) PHOTON TRANSPORT IS OFF ENTIRELY - ledger 5 showed source gammas lose to neutrons 71:1, but capture gammas BORN INSIDE a 4 m shield are a different term, are not modelled here, and are the classic late contributor in a thick shield. THAT IS THE GAP I WOULD CLOSE NEXT AND THE ONE THING THAT COULD PUSH THE CREST NUMBER BACK UP; (3) the cover is 4,831 m3 of dozer work. Ledger 5's conclusion that regolith is the cheapest thing in this design is REINFORCED, not weakened, by learning we have 1.64 m more margin than we thought.

STREAMING - ledger 5 declared it uncomputed; it is computed now, and the handbook number was being used in the wrong place (ledger 11). Through 1 m of cover with a 30 cm duct and a 25 cm detector puck on the exit: solid 1.00x, straight duct 5.23x, one 90-degree dog-leg 3.22x. ONE BEND RECOVERS ONLY 48% OF WHAT THE STRAIGHT DUCT LOST - a factor of 1.6, not the 1e2-1e3 ledger 5 quoted. The reason is ASPECT RATIO: this test is 30 cm through 1 m, i.e. 3.3:1, a fat short hole one bend cannot close, while the handbook's 1e2-per-bend assumes a long thin duct. The real 4 m cover gives 13:1, where bends work far better. NEW DESIGN RULE, this time with a reason: PENETRATIONS ARE SIZED BY ASPECT RATIO, NOT BY BEND COUNT, and get two bends minimum.

SECOND ROUND, L1, LEDGER 13 - MY SLOPE ARGUMENT WAS INCOMPLETE. This card said the 1:1.5 slope is 'conservative at 0.38 g where the driving stress scales with gravity but the fill's cohesion does not'. The mechanism is right and the statement is incomplete: THE FRICTIONAL RESISTANCE SCALES WITH GRAVITY TOO, AND CANCELS EXACTLY. For a dry cohesionless fill the factor of safety is tan(phi)/tan(beta), INDEPENDENT OF GRAVITY - 1.13 on either planet at 1:1.5 with phi = 37 deg, BELOW the 1.5 ordinary practice requires. Gravity helps only through the COHESION term, where it helps a great deal (at c = 2 kPa, FoS 1.84 on Mars against 1.40 on Earth). NEW REQUIREMENT: demonstrate c >= 2.1 kPa in the compacted fill, or flatten to 1:2 (which passes with no cohesion at all, at the cost of a mound base growing 52 -> 63 m and 44% more cover volume). THE ADVANTAGE THAT REALLY IS MARTIAN LIES ELSEWHERE: on Earth a pseudo-static seismic coefficient of 0.1-0.15 g would take 30% off the factor of safety, and Mars is the quietest terrestrial planet we have measured - InSight's largest event in four years was M4.7 at 2,000 km - so that term is negligible here.

BURYING A REACTOR IS 2.6x CHEAPER ON MARS, AND NOBODY HAD WRITTEN THAT DOWN (ledger 13): shielding buys AREAL MASS (g/cm2) and structure pays AREAL MASS TIMES g. The same 4 m of cover is 24.5 kPa here and 64.7 kPa on Earth - FOR THE SAME SHIELDING, A MARTIAN ROOF CARRIES 1/2.6 OF THE LOAD. But an 18 m clear span still gives a flat-slab moment of 992 kN.m per metre, and THE GEOMETRY HAS NOW BEEN HALF-FIXED: the central column line IS drawn into the vault (halving the span, quartering the moment). THE ARCHED LINER (a 3 m rise gives 331 kN/m of pure compression) IS STILL NOT DRAWN and is honestly flagged for the next revision. It is called a vault; so far it is only half shaped like one.

THIRD ROUND, L2+L1, LEDGER 14 - THE GAP LEDGER 11 NAMED FOR ITSELF, NOW CLOSED. Ledger 11 ran with photon transport off and wrote that capture gammas born inside a 4 m shield were 'the gap I would close next, and the one thing that could push the crest number back up'. The VM's photon cross sections stopped being served partway through the fetch (connection refused), so the job was SPLIT instead of abandoned: an L2 half in which OpenMC neutron transport gives the SPATIAL DISTRIBUTION OF CAPTURE through the shield - R(z), the source term for the secondary gammas - and an L1 half that propagates those gammas to the surface with a point kernel and a buildup factor. That split is arguably more transparent than a black-box coupled run: you can see where the gammas are born and how much shield each still has to cross. IT ALSO FIXED THE COMPOSITION: merging the two partial libraries leaves only Ti (1.0 wt%) without data, against the 19 wt% ledger 11's surrogate folded into stand-ins - a 19x improvement in fidelity.

IRON TAKES 63% OF THE CAPTURES, AND AN IRON CAPTURE IS A 7.65 MeV EVENT (ledger 14). Ranking by weight fraction over A times thermal capture cross-section, Fe-56 dominates, with Si-28 at 8.47 MeV, Al-27 at 7.73 and Ca-40 at 8.36 behind it. THE CRUX IS THAT A 7.6 MeV PHOTON IN SILICATE HAS AN ATTENUATION LENGTH OF 23 cm - LONGER THAN THE NEUTRONS' 19.0 cm. So a capture gamma born near the BACK of the shield only has to cross the few tens of centimetres that remain, while a neutron entering the front must cross 450. The gamma-to-neutron ratio therefore GROWS with thickness - exactly the mechanism ledger 11 feared. Computed: 64.3x at 4.5 m against 1.35x at 1 m. THIS SHIELD IS GAMMA-LIMITED AT 4.5 m, NOT NEUTRON-LIMITED.

BUT THE CONCLUSION SURVIVES AND NOT ONE CENTIMETRE OF COVER MOVES (ledger 14): the crest dose goes from ledger 11's neutron-only 0.026 uSv/h to 1.697 uSv/h, still 1/16 of the 26.7 uSv/h natural surface background. WHAT CHANGED IS THE STRUCTURE OF THE ANSWER, NOT THE ANSWER: anyone who later tries to trade cover thickness away will find it buys far less than ledger 5's exponential suggested, because they will be trading against lambda_gamma = 23 cm and not lambda_n = 19 cm. THE CHEAP KNOB, LOGGED AND NOT SPECIFIED: capture gammas are made by THERMAL neutrons, so a few centimetres of borated layer on the inner face of the cover (B-10 captures to 0.48 MeV, not 7.6) would largely remove the source. Boron is not obviously on this city's inventory, and it is NOT NEEDED - the crest already sits two decades below background. It is here so the next person knows which knob to turn.
physics: 指数与平方的竞赛决定了整张卡。屏蔽衰减 ~ exp(−t/λ)，距离衰减 ~ 1/r²。要多买一个数量级的防护，厚度只需 +2.3λ（本站 52 cm 土），距离却要 ×3.16。在 λ = 22.4 cm 的介质里，一米土等于把距离拉远 88 倍。**行星表面的屏蔽经济学就是这一行：你站在无限多的 λ 上面。**
中子而非伽马定尺寸：本堆中子对伽马的剂量比是 71:1，而风化层对快中子的移出长度（22.4 cm）比对 1 MeV 伽马的（约 14 cm）更长。**所以屏蔽按中子设计，伽马自动附送**。风化层缺氢是这里最大的遗憾——干硅酸盐只能靠 Si/Fe/O 的非弹性散射慢化，λ 比含水混凝土差约 40%。
覆土的第二重身份是热学的，而且方向相反：0.04 W/mK 的风化层是极好的保温层（hab-village-01 靠它把舱壳夜间热负荷从 325 压到 2 W/m²），对反应堆却意味着衰变热无路可走。**同一堆土，对居住舱是恩惠，对反应堆是麻烦**——所以本站的排热路径必须从覆土里穿出来，而不是往里排。
physics_en: The whole card is a race between an exponential and a square. Shield attenuation goes as exp(-t/lambda); distance goes as 1/r^2. Buying one more decade of protection costs +2.3 lambda of thickness (52 cm of dirt here) or a factor of 3.16 in distance. In a medium with lambda = 22.4 cm, one metre of cover is worth moving 88 times further away. THAT LINE IS THE WHOLE ECONOMICS OF SHIELDING ON A PLANETARY SURFACE: you are standing on an unlimited supply of lambda.

Neutrons and not gammas set the size: the dose ratio here is 71:1, and regolith's removal length for fast neutrons (22.4 cm) is longer than for 1 MeV gammas (about 14 cm). SO THE SHIELD IS DESIGNED ON NEUTRONS AND THE GAMMAS COME FREE. The absence of hydrogen is the real disappointment - dry silicate can only slow neutrons by inelastic scatter off Si, Fe and O, giving a lambda about 40% worse than hydrated concrete.

The cover's second identity is thermal, and it points the other way: regolith at 0.04 W/mK is superb insulation (hab-village-01 uses it to take a hull's night heat load from 325 to 2 W/m2) but for a reactor it means decay heat has nowhere to go. THE SAME PILE OF DIRT IS A GIFT TO A HABITAT AND A NUISANCE TO A REACTOR - which is why this plant's rejection path has to come out THROUGH the cover rather than into it.

pois.label: 振动与选址：碰不得的不是频率，是包络
pois.label_en: Vibration and siting: the trap is not the carrier, it is the envelope
pois.detail: sci-seis-01 给全城 24 h 连续振源定过线：10 m 处 ≤1.2e-6 m/s/√Hz。斯特林是 102 Hz 连续往复源，正面撞上这条线。而 pwr-grid-01 的火震支线卡早已埋好陷阱：**「50 Hz 本来就在地震频带之上」是错的辩护**——问题不在载波，在包络。本站因此得到一条设计规则，而这条规则顺手解决了另外两个问题。
pois.detail_en: sci-seis-01 set a line for every 24-hour source in the city: 1.2e-6 m/s/rtHz at 10 m. A Stirling is a continuous 102 Hz reciprocating source and walks straight into it. And pwr-grid-01's seismic-feeder card already laid the trap: '50 Hz is above the seismic band anyway' IS THE WRONG DEFENCE - the problem is not the carrier, it is the envelope. This plant therefore carries a design rule, and that rule happens to solve two other problems as well.

specs.隔振: 弹性支座 f_n = 10 Hz → 102 Hz 处传递率 0.0097（103×）
specs.候选 A 处衰减: 617 m 上 e^−75 —— 不是小数，是没有数
specs.设计规则: 全时定功率运行，160 kWe 基荷，失超时阶跃到 320 kWe

specs_en.Isolation: elastomeric mounts at f_n = 10 Hz -> transmissibility 0.0097 at 102 Hz (103x)
specs_en.Attenuation at candidate A: e^-75 over 617 m - not a small number, not a number at all
specs_en.Design rule: constant thermal power at all times; 160 kWe baseload, step to 320 kWe on a quench

sim: 载波路径（闸 1、2）：用 sci-seis-01 自己的地层参数（Vs 175 m/s、ρ 1650、Q 15）。单活塞不平衡力 m·ω²·x = 20.5 kN，对置安装抵消到 1e-3（ASRG 级平衡），8 台非相干合成 58.1 N。Lysmer 半空间阻抗给基础速度，再按 1/√r · exp(−αr) 传播。**三种基础模型**：单模块 3 m 墩硬装 3.2×、共用 23×15 m 筏板 15×、筏板+隔振 **1,554×**。**3.2 倍不是余量，是抛硬币**，所以设计不依赖它：转换器对置于 f_n = 10 Hz 弹性支座上，这是普通机械工程做法，成本是橡胶。
**注意隔振器自身的 10 Hz 共振落在该站 SP 频带内**，所以它绝不能被激励：斯特林定频运行在 102 Hz（10.2 倍以上），启动时扫过 10 Hz 是一次有计划、通报过的事件，不是常态。

**闸 3，包络：这是本卡真正的内容。** 若本站跟随城市负荷，活塞振幅就跟着负荷走，等于把城市负荷曲线写进地里。低频不衰减：1e-5 Hz 上 α = 1.2e-8 /m，617 m 的衰减是 exp(−7.4e-6) = 0.999993。**没有任何距离能跑赢一条包络。** 这正是火震支线卡用来枪毙交流馈线的同一条论证（绕组力 ∝ I²，一个 sol 一次的 4.1 倍力比落在 ~1e-5 Hz）。
**设计规则（也是本站最划算的一笔）：全时定功率。** 八台常年 50% 运行，160 kWe 基荷送城，失超时才阶跃到 100%。恒定振幅 = 没有被调制的音调；阶跃是**台阶**不是音调——正是该卡当年为直流辩护时划下的那条区别。

**这条规则的代价与三重收益。** 160 kWe 常年运行等于让聚变站少出 160 kWe，按 pwr-grid-01 的 5.45 kWh/kg 折算是每会合窗口 0.55 kt 甲烷氧，对 618 kt 出口的 **0.089%**。用这 0.089% 同时买到：① 恒幅振源（本卡）；② **一台每一秒都在证明自己能转的备份**——待机电源的失效模式就是它起不来；③ 分钟级阶跃而不是 4~8 h 冷启动（见接入卡）。

方位这条杠杆算了但**没有用它定址**：从火震站看，候选 B 落在离矿场方位仅 24° 处（该站噪声预算已经承载了那个方位），候选 A 则开了一个 48° 的干净方位。**这是 sci-radio-01 零陷的地震镜像：对射电阵要躲进已有的零陷，对火震仪要躲在已有的振源背后。** 本站不靠它，是因为 102 Hz 在 8.2 m 吸收长度下任何方位都到不了；**但如果后续版本改用透平（几 Hz），这条就会变成决定性的，所以先记录在案。**

还能辐射的东西都点名排除：NaK 电磁泵（直线感应，无运动件，磁致伸缩在 kHz，比 VBB 带顶高六个数量级）；控制鼓（只在启停时动，十年两次）；辐射板（流速不足以产生流致振动，热胀是季节性斜坡不是音调）；冷却泵（**根本没有**——这就是为什么转换选型卡和本卡是同一个决定）。**诚实剩余风险**：102 Hz 可能激起 5.5 m 悬臂板的一阶弯曲模态，使大面积板变成对地辐射器。措施：板脚与筏板之间做弹性隔离，一阶频率作为**投运实测项**而不是假设。

**【第二轮 · 账 8 的回赠】** 本卡为杜绝低频包络，把「全时定功率、5 kW/s 限速」定成设计规则，并把代价算成 0.089% 的推进剂出口。账 8 建完直流母线时域模型后发现这条规则**同时**在买第二样东西：两个构网源（1 ms 的储能 PCS 与 32 s 爬坡的裂变）因此在时间常数上差四个数量级，**结构性地打不起来**，后跳闸工作点全部特征值 Re<0。**一条为地震定的约束，顺手把电力控制的稳定性也付清了。**

**【第三轮 · 账 15：本卡漏掉的那个振源，而且它不怕距离】** 本卡把机械噪声定性为「高频问题、靠距离解决」，并算出 102 Hz 载波在 617 m 上衰减到 e⁻⁷⁵。**这对斯特林是对的，对辐射板不成立。** 板的一阶弯曲模态在 3.62 Hz，**吸收长度 231 m 而不是 8.2 m**,617 m 上只衰减到 8.0e-8 m/s。而激励源也不是斯特林——**自由活塞机没有曲轴、没有齿轮、没有旋转不平衡，产生不了 1/28 次谐波**；真正的激励是**风的湍流抖振**，它一直都在。**这是本册第三次出现同一个模式**：我特地去查的那一项（账 12 的土丘视角、账 10 的法拉第笼、本卡的斯特林次谐波）都可以忽略，**而我没点名的那一项才是活的**。修正见 radiator 卡：中层横撑 + 1.5 Hz 板脚隔振，两者缺一不可。
sim_en: The carrier path (gates 1 and 2), on sci-seis-01's own ground parameters (Vs 175 m/s, rho 1650, Q 15). Single-piston unbalanced force m.omega^2.x = 20.5 kN, cancelled to 1e-3 by opposed mounting (ASRG-class balancing), summed incoherently across eight modules to 58.1 N. A Lysmer half-space impedance gives the foundation velocity, propagated as 1/sqrt(r).exp(-alpha.r). THREE FOUNDATION MODELS: a hard-mounted 3 m module pad gives 3.2x, a shared 23 x 15 m raft 15x, and raft plus isolation 1,554x. 3.2x IS NOT MARGIN, IT IS A COIN TOSS, so the design does not rely on it: converters sit opposed on elastomeric mounts at f_n = 10 Hz. That is ordinary machinery practice and it costs rubber.

NOTE THAT THE ISOLATOR'S OWN 10 Hz RESONANCE LIES INSIDE THAT STATION'S SP BAND, so it must never be excited: the Stirling runs at a fixed 102 Hz, 10.2x above it, and the startup sweep through 10 Hz is a scheduled, announced event rather than a normal condition.

GATE 3, THE ENVELOPE - THIS IS WHAT THE CARD IS ACTUALLY ABOUT. If this plant followed the city load, piston amplitude would track load and write the city's demand curve into the ground. Low frequencies do not attenuate: at 1e-5 Hz, alpha = 1.2e-8 /m and 617 m of attenuation is exp(-7.4e-6) = 0.999993. NO DISTANCE OUTRUNS AN ENVELOPE. This is the same argument the seismic-feeder card used to kill an AC feeder (winding forces go as I^2, and a 4.1x force ratio once per sol lands near 1e-5 Hz).

THE DESIGN RULE, AND THE BEST BARGAIN ON THIS SITE: CONSTANT THERMAL POWER AT ALL TIMES. All eight modules run at 50% year-round, exporting 160 kWe of baseload, and step to 100% only on a quench. Constant amplitude means no modulated tone, and a step change is a STEP, not a tone - exactly the distinction that card drew in favour of DC.

WHAT THE RULE COSTS, AND THE THREE THINGS IT BUYS. Running 160 kWe continuously displaces 160 kWe of fusion output, which pwr-grid-01 converts at 5.45 kWh/kg into 0.55 kt of methalox per synod - 0.089% of a 618 kt export. That 0.089% buys, simultaneously: (1) a constant-amplitude seismic source (this card); (2) A BACKUP THAT PROVES IT RUNS EVERY SECOND OF ITS LIFE - the failure mode of standby plant is that it does not start; (3) a minutes-long step to full power instead of a 4-8 h cold start (see the tie card).

The azimuth lever was computed and DELIBERATELY NOT USED TO PICK THE SITE: seen from the seismic vault, candidate B lies only 24 degrees off the bearing to res-mine-01 - an azimuth that station's noise budget already carries - while candidate A opens a clean one at 48 degrees. THIS IS THE SEISMIC MIRROR OF sci-radio-01's NULL: for the radio array you want to hide inside an existing null, for the seismometer you want to hide behind an existing source. It does not decide the site here because at 102 Hz with an 8.2 m absorption length nothing arrives on any azimuth - BUT IF A LATER REVISION ADOPTS A TURBINE AT A FEW Hz IT WOULD BECOME DECISIVE, so it is on the record.

Everything else that could radiate is named and excluded: the NaK electromagnetic pumps (linear induction, no moving parts, magnetostriction at kHz, six decades above the VBB top); the control drums (startup and scram only, twice a decade); the radiator panels (no flow velocity high enough for flow-induced vibration; thermal expansion is a seasonal ramp, not a tone); the coolant pumps (THERE ARE NONE - which is why the conversion card and this card are the same decision). HONEST RESIDUAL RISK: 102 Hz could excite the first bending mode of a 5.5 m cantilevered panel, turning a large area into a radiator of sound into the ground. Mitigation: panel footings are elastomerically isolated from the raft, and first-mode frequency is a COMMISSIONING MEASUREMENT, not an assumption.

SECOND ROUND - A GIFT BACK FROM LEDGER 8. This card imposed 'constant thermal power, 5 kW/s ramp limit' to kill the low-frequency envelope, and priced it at 0.089% of the propellant export. The DC-bus time-domain model in ledger 8 showed the same rule buys a second thing: it separates the two grid-forming sources - a 1 ms storage PCS against a 32 s fission ramp - by four decades in time constant, so they CANNOT FIGHT, and every eigenvalue at the post-trip operating point has Re < 0. ONE CONSTRAINT IMPOSED FOR SEISMIC REASONS PAID THE POWER-CONTROL STABILITY DEBT AS WELL.

THIRD ROUND, LEDGER 15 - THE SOURCE THIS CARD MISSED, AND IT DOES NOT FEAR DISTANCE. This card classified mechanical noise as 'a high-frequency problem solved by distance' and computed the 102 Hz carrier down to e^-75 at 617 m. THAT IS TRUE OF THE STIRLING AND FALSE OF THE RADIATOR PANELS. Their first bending mode sits at 3.62 Hz, where the absorption length is 231 m and not 8.2 m, so 617 m only takes it to 8.0e-8 m/s. And the exciter is not the Stirling either - a free-piston machine has no crank, no gearbox and no rotating unbalance, so it cannot generate a sub-harmonic at f/28. The live exciter is WIND BUFFETING, which is always present. THIS IS THE THIRD TIME THE SAME PATTERN HAS APPEARED IN THIS DOSSIER: the term I went looking for (ledger 12's berm view factor, ledger 10's Faraday cage, this card's Stirling sub-harmonic) was negligible, and THE ONE I HAD NOT NAMED WAS THE LIVE ONE. The fix is on the radiator card: a mid-height cross rail plus 1.5 Hz footing isolation, and neither alone is enough.
physics: 机械噪声是高频问题，靠距离解决；风噪声是低频问题，靠罩子和夜晚解决——sci-seis-01 安静卡的这句话在本站得到最极端的例证。滞弹衰减 α = πf/(QVs) 正比于频率：102 Hz 上 8.2 m 一个 e 折，1e-5 Hz 上 8.2e7 m 一个 e 折。**同一块地，对载波是黑洞，对包络是完全透明。** 于是所有的工程努力都必须花在「不产生低频包络」上，而不是花在「离得更远」上。
对置抵消的物理是一阶惯性力的矢量相消：两台同频反相的往复机，其 m·ω²·x 项符号相反。它不消二阶力（∝ 2ω），但自由活塞机的二阶项本来就小，且 204 Hz 更加远离任何人关心的频带。这也是为什么本站宁可要往复机也不要旋转机——旋转不平衡是**不可抵消**的（只能做动平衡，而残余量随磨损增长），往复不平衡可以靠对称布置结构性地消掉。
physics_en: Mechanical noise is a high-frequency problem solved by distance; wind noise is a low-frequency problem solved by a shroud and by night. sci-seis-01's own sentence gets its most extreme illustration here. Anelastic absorption alpha = pi.f/(Q.Vs) is proportional to frequency: one e-fold in 8.2 m at 102 Hz, one e-fold in 8.2e7 m at 1e-5 Hz. THE SAME GROUND IS A BLACK HOLE TO THE CARRIER AND PERFECTLY TRANSPARENT TO THE ENVELOPE. So all the engineering effort has to go into not generating a low-frequency envelope, not into standing further away.

Opposed cancellation is vector subtraction of the first-order inertial force: two reciprocating machines at the same frequency in antiphase carry m.omega^2.x terms of opposite sign. It does not cancel the second-order term at 2.omega, but a free-piston machine's second-order content is small to begin with and 204 Hz is even further from anything anyone cares about. It is also why a reciprocating machine is preferred here over a rotating one: rotating unbalance CANNOT be cancelled structurally - it can only be balanced, and the residual grows with wear - whereas reciprocating unbalance can be removed by symmetry.

pois.label: 接入柜与黑启动：孤岛不再是秒表
pois.label_en: The tie cubicle and black start: the island stops being a stopwatch
pois.detail: 朝电网方向的接入柜与两条出线沟头。本站在 ±10 kV 直流干线上并网，并**另拉一条常开的直供地下城支线**——因为 pwr-grid-01 虽然厂内 N−1，它仍然是一栋楼。柜后是控制掩体（在土丘背面，山就是它的屏蔽），里面那只 30 kWh 电池是全站唯一的储能，也是黑启动的全部本钱。
pois.detail_en: The access cubicle facing the grid, with two outgoing trench heads. This plant ties in at the +/-10 kV DC trunk AND runs a second, normally-open feeder direct to the undercity - because pwr-grid-01 is N-1 inside the building but it is still one building. Behind it, on the far side of the mound where the hill is its shield, is the control bunker; the 30 kWh pack inside is the only stored energy on this site and the entire capital for a black start.

specs.并网点: ±10 kV 直流双极干线（极间 20 kV），16.0 A
specs.变换链: 8 × 有源整流 → 1500 V 模块母线 → 2 × 160 kW DC-DC（N−1）→ ±10 kV
specs.双走廊: G-R 进变电站（与聚变进线 G-A 分离 110°）+ G-S 常开直供地下城
specs.黑启动能量: 7.5 kWh 需求 / 30 kWh 电池 = 4.0×（约 200 kg）
specs.冷启动 → 满功率: 4~8 h（电池桥 33 h，余量 4.1×）；热态阶跃：分钟级
specs.EMC 要求（账 10）: 共模电流 ≤1.7 µA/100 kHz → 0.5 MHz 处 42 dB

specs_en.Connection point: +/-10 kV bipolar DC trunk (20 kV pole-to-pole), 16.0 A
specs_en.Why not the district bus: over the same 793 m, 1500 V needs 27.1 t of aluminium against 153 kg at 20 kV (178x)
specs_en.Conversion chain: 8 active rectifiers -> 1500 V module bus -> 2 x 160 kW DC-DC (N-1) -> +/-10 kV
specs_en.Two corridors: G-R into the substation (110 deg off the fusion incomer G-A) + G-S normally open, direct to the undercity
specs_en.Black-start energy: 7.5 kWh needed against a 30 kWh pack = 4.0x (about 200 kg)
specs_en.Cold start to full power: 4-8 h against a 33 h battery bridge, 4.1x margin; from hot standby, minutes
specs_en.EMC requirement (ledger 10): CM current <= 1.7 uA per 100 kHz -> 42 dB at 0.5 MHz

sim: **电压选择用 pwr-grid-01 自己的质量律复算，不是遵从。** 该册阀厅卡的工作例：1,126 m 送 400 kW、20 kV 极间、20 A、271 kg 铝。按 m ∝ 1/V² 缩放到本站的 793 m / 320 kW：20 kV 要 **153 kg**，1500 V 区配要 **27.1 t**（178 倍），400 V 要 382 t。同一条式子，同一个答案。而且本站本来就产直流——斯特林直线发电机出 102 Hz 单相，在模块内就整流掉。**全站没有一处工频磁性元件，火震支线卡对西部科学支路的那条规则在本站是构造性满足的。**

**没人点名的那个单点：pwr-grid-01 自己。** 它厂内 N−1（2 × 4 MVA 变流块），但它是一栋楼。两个电源都落在同一条母线上，等于把本站要消除的单点故障又造了一遍。交付方案是**两条走廊**：G-R 主路进变电站直流母线，且从与聚变进线 G-A 相反的象限进（候选 A 处分离 110°）；G-S 副路常开，直通 hab-tunnel-01 地下城 1500 V 区节点，失去变电站时闭合。G-S 只带 T1+作物存活的 127 kW，每公里约 86 kg 铝——用一笔零头买断本册否则会视而不见的那个资产。**两条走廊都归总控铺设（MODELS.md 门口规矩），本模块只做接入柜与几米短接。**

**黑启动：备份电源的价值核心。** 自由活塞斯特林**靠热自启动**，不需要电动盘车（KRUSTY 即如此）。钠热管在 215 K 是冻的（钠 371 K 熔化），教科书陷阱是「唯一的冷却通道被冻住了」——这里不成立：先让堆芯在几 kW 临界，固体堆芯块的热传导足以带走，热管从蒸发段向外自行解冻。**不需要电加热解冻。** 于是黑启动清单只剩控制鼓转动 0.5 kWh、仪控 12 h 6.0 kWh、斯特林控制器励磁 1.0 kWh，合计 **7.5 kWh**。30 kWh 电池给 4 倍余量，约 200 kg。**这是全站唯一的储能。**
时间账：冷启动 4~8 h（受热管浸润与热应力速率限制，不受中子学限制——快堆几乎没有氙）。**电池桥是 1.33 sol = 33 h，余量 4.1 倍。** 而热态（50% 基荷，正常状态）阶跃到满功率只要分钟。**真正在赛跑的对手是「失超后聚变复电要数周」，本站赢三个数量级。**
下垂协调：两个构网源在同一条直流母线上，要在**频域**而不是幅度上分工。裂变 DC-DC 走 2% V-P 下垂并限速 5 kW/s——慢而硬，定住母线均值、供能量；储能 PCS 走虚拟电容（响应 dV/dt）——快而软，吃掉全部暂态、稳态出力为零。两者永不争夺设定点。**这不是新控制模式**，正是 pwr-storage-01 现在对聚变站跑的那套分工，只是慢角色换人。
切换序列：t=0 聚变变流器封锁、进线分闸 → t<1 ms 储能 PCS（2 MW）接住全城 610 kW 不减载负荷 → t=0~60 s 裂变按 5 kW/s 从 160 爬到 320 kWe（32 s）→ t≈5 min 减载梯到 T1+T2+T2c 的 275 kW ≤ 320 kW → **电池净电流归零并开始回充**。

**闸 3：孤岛还是不是秒表？** pwr-grid-01 说「孤岛是一只秒表，不是一堵墙」：20 MWh ÷ 610 kW = 1.33 sol，T1+T2 则 3.7 sol。**接上本站（N−1 的 280 kWe firm）之后，275 kW 的受保护层净电池消耗为 −5 kW —— 秒表停了。** 那 20 MWh 于是彻底换了工作：它不再是让人活下去的东西，而是桥接 60 秒的东西，并转为对 N−2 裂变事件的**后备**，在 T1 上仍值 10.4 sol。
**衰变热与邻居的不对称，值得单独说一句。** pwr-fusion-01 全站失电时必须把 15 GJ 环向场储能倒进 100 t 电阻体，因为维持磁体低温要 71 MWh、是全城储能的 3.6 倍。本站的同一事件成本为零：它只是变热，然后辐射掉。**这不是细节，这就是「为什么备份该是一台裂变机」——它的安全状态是被动的，它的复电以小时计。**

**【第二轮 L2 · 账 8：这张卡被自己的时域模型改了】** 本卡原写「储能 PCS 走虚拟电容（响应 dV/dt）、稳态出力为零」。建直流母线时域模型（全网络含馈线 1.4 mH 与 0.8 mF，前 2 s 全解、其后按奇异摄动降阶，两模型在重叠窗内差 0.0003%）后，**这条控制律是错的**：零直流增益的电源撑不住持续缺额——裂变饱和在 320 kW 之后，洗出滤波把电池贡献衰减掉，**母线在 t=3,817 s 跌破 −10% 并继续下滑到 −15%**。**交付改为**：PCS 保持普通 5% 下垂（非零直流增益），「稳态为零」由**裂变侧二次调节**慢慢把设定点走到电池读零来实现。标准的分层控制——原卡把「稳态归零」这项工作派给了错误的机器。

**切换实测（账 8）**：t=0 聚变封锁 → 母线最深跌落 **−1.12%**（电池以 2 kW/V 下垂接住 450 kW，只要 225 V 偏差）→ 裂变按 5 kW/s 爬升，t=32 s 到 301 kW → t=120 s 电池回到 +2.7 kW → t≥300 s 裂变 266 kW、电池归零。**全过程电池只出 2.32 kWh = 全城储能的 0.012%**。峰值电池功率 450 kW 对 2 MW PCS 有 4.4 倍余量。**孤岛曾经是能量问题，切换之后连能量问题都不是。**

**新结论（账 8）：减载梯买的是续航，不是稳定。** 本卡原来暗示减载梯对接管本身是承重的。不是——PCS 带真实下垂时，不减载的 610 kW 对 320 kW 裂变只是让母线按缺额比例**下垂 0.73% 并稳住**，一直到 20 MWh 在 2.80 sol 后耗尽为止。**没有崩溃，只有一只更慢的秒表。** 减载从 2 s 推迟到「永不」，最深跌落只从 −1.124% 变到 −1.095%。

**稳定性（账 8，小信号）**：后跳闸工作点全部特征值 Re<0，最慢极点是 87 s 的二次调节环。馈线 LC 模态 **336 Hz、ζ=0.21**（解析式与特征值差 1.6%）。经典的直流微网失稳是恒功率负荷的**负增量电阻**吃掉线路电阻——本网需要 **317 MW** 的母线负荷才会发生，是 ISRU 战役峰值的 121 倍、全城峰值的 295 倍。**不是本站的活故障模式，而原因很平凡：793 m 铝馈线是有电阻的。**超导或极短馈线上这条余量会蒸发。**而两个构网源之所以打不起来是结构性的**——1 ms 对 32 s 的爬坡，差四个数量级。**账 7 那条为地震定的 5 kW/s 限速，同时也是让这个控制回路平凡稳定的东西。**

**【第二轮 L1 · 账 10：EMC 这条我声明过却没算过，现在算了，而且两处说错】** 本卡曾把焊封钢衬里法拉第笼称作「唯一的承重措施」并只给了一句话。做完排放链路预算：**① 天线不是设备，是那条 793 m 馈线**（0.5 MHz 上 1.32λ,10 MHz 上 26λ）。衬里挡的是设备的直接辐射，对沿馈线导出的共模电流毫无作用，而风化层在 HF 完全透明。**承重的是穿墙共模滤波器与联结电缆屏蔽，不是笼子。** **② 难度被夸大了**：用 sci-radio-01 自己的两个判据独立推导（W/Hz 容限路线 3.53 µA、−91.7 dBm 杂散限路线 1.68 µA，相差 6.5 dB），要求是**共模电流 ≤1.7 µA/100 kHz 通道**，对应 **0.5 MHz 处 42 dB 抑制**——一只共模扼流圈加一层联结屏蔽就够，是普通安装规范，不是艰难让步。

**别给变流器加扩频抖动（账 10，反直觉且必须写死）**：商用 EMC 的标准做法是抖动开关频率把谐波抹开以压低准峰值读数。**用在这里是有害的。** 稳定的谱线落在已知频率上，射电阵把那个通道标记掉即可——廉价、无损、标准做法；**被抖开的谱线变成无法标记的宽带污染，因为不再有干净通道可作对照**。抖动是拿「少数通道全损」换「全部通道小损」，而射电天文宁要前者。**交付规范四条**：① 馈线共模抑制 ≥42 dB，以钳形电流表实测验收，不接受「机柜密封」这种说法;② 开关时钟锁到全城时基（sci-seis-01 那条链,sci-cray-01 已共用），让梳状谱落在可预判的固定栅格上;③ **禁用扩频抖动，且必须写进采购规格——所有商用变流器出厂默认是开的**;④ 装料前先用阵列做一次投运扫频（变流器可以先挂城网跑）。
sim_en: THE VOLTAGE CHOICE IS RE-DERIVED ON pwr-grid-01's OWN MASS LAW, not deferred to. Their valve-hall worked example: 1,126 m delivering 400 kW at 20 kV pole-to-pole, 20 A, 271 kg of aluminium. Scaling by m ~ 1/V^2 to this plant's 793 m and 320 kW: 20 kV needs 153 kg, the 1500 V district bus needs 27.1 t (178x), and 400 V needs 382 t. Same expression, same answer. The plant makes DC natively anyway - the Stirling linear alternators put out 102 Hz single phase and it is rectified inside the module. THERE IS NO LINE-FREQUENCY MAGNETIC COMPONENT ANYWHERE ON THIS SITE, so the seismic-feeder card's rule for the western science branch is satisfied by construction.

THE SINGLE POINT NOBODY NAMED: pwr-grid-01 ITSELF. It is N-1 inside the building (2 x 4 MVA converter blocks) but it is one building. Landing both sources on one busbar rebuilds exactly the single point of failure this plant exists to remove. The delivered answer is TWO CORRIDORS: G-R primary into the substation's DC busbar, entering from the opposite quarter to the fusion incomer G-A (110 degrees apart at candidate A); and G-S secondary, normally open, running direct to hab-tunnel-01's undercity 1500 V district node and closing on loss of the substation. G-S carries only T1 plus crop survival, 127 kW, at about 86 kg of aluminium per kilometre - small change to close out the one asset this dossier would otherwise have ignored. BOTH CORRIDORS ARE MAIN CONTROL'S TO LAY (MODELS.md doorstep rule); this module builds the cubicle and a few metres of stub.

BLACK START - THE VALUE CORE OF A BACKUP. A free-piston Stirling SELF-STARTS ON HEAT and needs no motoring (KRUSTY did exactly this). The sodium heat pipes are frozen at 215 K (sodium melts at 371 K), and the textbook trap is that the only cooling path is frozen - which does not apply: take the core critical at a few kW first, let conduction through the solid core block carry it, and the pipes thaw from the evaporator outward. NO ELECTRIC THAW IS REQUIRED. The black-start list is then only 0.5 kWh to rotate the drums, 6.0 kWh for 12 h of I&C and 1.0 kWh of Stirling controller excitation: 7.5 kWh total. A 30 kWh pack gives 4x margin at about 200 kg. IT IS THE ONLY STORED ENERGY ON THIS SITE.

The time account: a cold start is 4-8 h, limited by heat-pipe wetting and a controlled thermal ramp rather than by neutronics (a fast core has almost no xenon). THE BATTERY BRIDGE IS 1.33 sol = 33 h, A MARGIN OF 4.1x. From hot standby - 50% baseload, the normal state - the step to full power is minutes. THE ACTUAL COMPETITOR IS 'FUSION TAKES WEEKS TO COME BACK AFTER A QUENCH', AND THIS PLANT WINS BY THREE ORDERS OF MAGNITUDE.

Droop coordination: two grid-forming sources on one DC bus must be separated in FREQUENCY, not in magnitude. The fission DC-DC runs a 2% V-P droop with a 5 kW/s ramp limit - slow and stiff, holding the bus average and supplying energy; the storage PCS runs virtual capacitance, responding to dV/dt - fast and soft, absorbing every transient with zero steady output. They never argue about the set-point. THIS IS NOT A NEW CONTROL MODE - it is the split pwr-storage-01 already runs against the fusion plant, with a different occupant in the slow role.

Switchover: t = 0, the fusion converter blanks and the incomer opens; t < 1 ms, the 2 MW storage PCS picks up the city's whole 610 kW unshed load; t = 0-60 s, fission ramps 160 -> 320 kWe at 5 kW/s (32 s); t ~ 5 min, the shed ladder reaches T1+T2+T2c at 275 kW, which is under the 320 kW available; and THE BATTERY'S NET CURRENT GOES TO ZERO AND IT BEGINS TO RECHARGE.

GATE 3: IS THE ISLAND STILL A STOPWATCH? pwr-grid-01 says 'islanding is a stopwatch, not a wall' - 20 MWh / 610 kW = 1.33 sol, or 3.7 sol at T1+T2. WITH THIS PLANT AT ITS N-1 FIRM 280 kWe, the 275 kW protected tier draws -5 kW net from the battery. THE STOPWATCH STOPS. Those 20 MWh change job completely: no longer the thing keeping people alive, but the thing bridging sixty seconds - and RESERVE against an N-2 fission event, where at T1 it is still worth 10.4 sol.

THE ASYMMETRY WITH THE NEIGHBOUR IS WORTH ONE SENTENCE OF ITS OWN. On a total blackout pwr-fusion-01 must dump 15 GJ of toroidal-field energy into 100 t of resistor, because holding the magnets cold would take 71 MWh - 3.6x the entire city store. The same event costs this plant nothing at all: it gets warm and radiates. THAT IS NOT A DETAIL, IT IS THE WHOLE REASON THE BACKUP SHOULD BE A FISSION MACHINE - its safe state is passive and its restart is measured in hours.

SECOND ROUND, L2, LEDGER 8 - THIS CARD WAS CORRECTED BY ITS OWN TIME-DOMAIN MODEL. It used to say the storage PCS 'responds to dV/dt, zero average'. Building the DC-bus model (full network with the 1.4 mH feeder and 0.8 mF of link capacitance for the first 2 s, then a singular-perturbation reduction; the two agree to 0.0003% in the overlap) shows that control law is WRONG: a source with zero DC gain cannot hold a sustained deficit. Once fission saturates at 320 kW the washout decays the battery's contribution and THE BUS FALLS THROUGH -10% AT t = 3,817 s and keeps going to -15%. DELIVERED INSTEAD: the PCS keeps an ordinary 5% droop (non-zero DC gain) and the 'zero average' is produced by a SECONDARY controller on the FISSION side, walking its setpoint until the battery reads zero. Standard hierarchical control - the card had given the zero-average job to the wrong machine.

THE SWITCHOVER, MEASURED (ledger 8): at t = 0 the fusion converter blanks and the bus dips to -1.12% (the battery's 2 kW/V droop picks up 450 kW on 225 V of deviation); fission ramps at 5 kW/s and reaches 301 kW by t = 32 s; the battery is back to +2.7 kW by t = 120 s; and beyond t = 300 s fission carries 266 kW with the battery at zero. THE WHOLE TRANSIENT COSTS 2.32 kWh - 0.012% of the city store. Peak battery power is 450 kW against a 2 MW PCS, 4.4x margin. Islanding used to be an energy problem; after the handover it is not even that.

NEW RESULT (ledger 8): THE SHED LADDER BUYS ENDURANCE, NOT STABILITY. This card implied the ladder was load-bearing for the takeover itself. It is not. With a real droop on the PCS, an unshed 610 kW against 320 kW of fission simply sags the bus 0.73% in proportion to the deficit and HOLDS THERE, until the 20 MWh runs out after 2.80 sol. No collapse, just a slower stopwatch. Moving the shed from 2 s to never moves the worst excursion from -1.124% to -1.095%.

STABILITY (ledger 8, small signal): every eigenvalue at the post-trip operating point has Re < 0, the slowest pole being the 87 s secondary loop. The feeder LC mode sits at 336 Hz with zeta = 0.21 (analytic and eigenvalue agree to 1.6%). The classic DC-microgrid instability - constant-power loads' NEGATIVE incremental resistance cancelling the line resistance - would need 317 MW on this bus, 121x the ISRU campaign peak and 295x the whole city peak. NOT A LIVE FAILURE MODE HERE, for the mundane reason that a 793 m aluminium feeder is a resistive one; on a superconducting or very short feeder the margin evaporates. And the two grid-forming sources cannot fight because they are separated STRUCTURALLY - 1 ms against a 32 s ramp, four decades apart. THE 5 kW/s LIMIT LEDGER 7 IMPOSED FOR SEISMIC REASONS IS ALSO WHAT MAKES THIS CONTROL LOOP TRIVIALLY STABLE.

SECOND ROUND, L1, LEDGER 10 - I DECLARED THIS ONE LOAD-BEARING WITHOUT COMPUTING IT, AND GOT TWO THINGS WRONG. This card called the welded steel liner 'the single load-bearing measure' and gave it one sentence. With the emission link budget built: (1) THE ANTENNA IS NOT THE EQUIPMENT, IT IS THE 793 m FEEDER (1.32 wavelengths at 0.5 MHz, 26 at 10 MHz). A liner attenuates what the equipment radiates directly and does nothing about common-mode current conducted out along the cable, while regolith is transparent at HF. THE LOAD-BEARING ITEMS ARE THE FEEDTHROUGH COMMON-MODE FILTER AND THE BONDED CABLE SCREEN, NOT THE CAGE. (2) THE DIFFICULTY WAS OVERSTATED: derived twice from sci-radio-01's own numbers - 3.53 uA from their W/Hz allowance and 1.68 uA from their -91.7 dBm spurious limit, 6.5 dB apart - the requirement is a common-mode current below 1.7 uA per 100 kHz channel, i.e. 42 dB of suppression at 0.5 MHz. One common-mode choke plus a bonded screen. Ordinary installation practice, not a hard-won concession.

DO NOT DITHER THE CONVERTERS (ledger 10 - counter-intuitive, and it has to be written down). Standard commercial EMC practice is to dither the switching frequency so harmonics smear and the quasi-peak reading drops. HERE IT IS HARMFUL. A stable line sits at a known frequency and a radio array flags that channel - cheap, lossless, standard. A DITHERED line becomes broadband contamination that cannot be flagged, because no clean channel is left to flag against. Dithering trades a total loss of a few channels for a small loss of all of them, and radio astronomy much prefers the former. DELIVERED SPECIFICATION: (1) common-mode suppression >= 42 dB on the feeder, accepted as a CLAMP-METER CURRENT MEASUREMENT and not as an enclosure claim; (2) switching clock phase-locked to the city time reference (sci-seis-01's chain, already shared by sci-cray-01) so the comb lands on a predictable grid; (3) NO spread-spectrum dithering, written into the purchase specification because every commercial converter ships with it enabled; (4) a commissioning sweep with the array as receiver before the reactor is fuelled - the converters can run on the city bus first.
physics: 帕邢陷阱在本站是构造性回避的：全站唯一超过 249 V 的部位都在焊封钢衬里或固体绝缘内，因为 6 mbar CO₂ 下任何毫米级气隙在 249 V 就击穿（pwr-grid-01 母线卡）。而钢衬里同时是**法拉第笼**——这一点必须点破：**风化层在 HF 波段是透明的**，3 MHz 上趋肤深度约 3 km，所以「埋起来」对射频屏蔽的贡献是**零**。sci-radio-01 的 30 dB 零陷对准城区，本站落在城区方位之外，**得不到零陷保护**。因此钢衬里加穿墙滤波器不是可选项，它是本站满足全城 HF 排放纪律的唯一承重措施。
直流母线上没有旋转电机，所以短路电流没有次暂态分量——每一个电源都是可以被叫停的变流器（pwr-grid-01 账 7）。本站的加入不改变这条：斯特林后面是有源整流器，故障时封锁即停。这也是为什么本站的接入不需要重新做全网短路计算，只需要把两台 DC-DC 的限流电抗计进去。
physics_en: The Paschen trap is avoided here by construction: everything above 249 V lives inside a welded steel liner or in solid insulation, because in 6 mbar of CO2 any millimetre-scale gap breaks down at 249 V (pwr-grid-01's busduct card). That liner is simultaneously a FARADAY CAGE - and this has to be said plainly: REGOLITH IS TRANSPARENT AT HF. The skin depth at 3 MHz is about 3 km, so burial contributes exactly ZERO RF attenuation. sci-radio-01's 30 dB null is aimed at the city, and this plant sits outside the city's azimuth sector, so IT GETS NO PROTECTION FROM THAT NULL. The steel liner plus feedthrough filters is therefore not an option but the single load-bearing measure by which this site meets the city's HF emission discipline.

There is no rotating machine on the DC bus, so a short circuit has no subtransient contribution - every source is a converter that can be told to stop (pwr-grid-01, ledger 7). Adding this plant does not change that: an active rectifier sits behind each Stirling and blanking stops it. Which is why this connection does not require the network short-circuit study to be redone - only the two DC-DC limiting reactors need to be added to it.
